::: {.csf-section}
<p class="csf-section__kicker">what it takes</p>
<h2 class="csf-section__title">Less than you'd think</h2>
<p class="csf-section__sub">
No venue to rent, no equipment to buy, no budget to raise. Just these four things.
</p>

::: {.csf-grid .csf-grid--4}
::: {.csf-card .csf-card--butter}
<span class="csf-card__icon"><i class="bi bi-table"></i></span>

### A table and a fridge
A shared flat, a cohousing common room, a student residence, a friend's kitchen. Anywhere
people can stand around a table.
:::

::: {.csf-card .csf-card--berry}
<span class="csf-card__icon"><i class="bi bi-basket2-fill"></i></span>

### Cheap ingredients
Biscuits, chocolate, cream, fruit. Our recipes are picked to feed a crowd from a single
supermarket run.
:::

::: {.csf-card .csf-card--pista}
<span class="csf-card__icon"><i class="bi bi-people-fill"></i></span>

### Ten-ish curious people
Flatmates, classmates, colleagues, a post in a local group. Strangers are welcome; that's
the point.
:::

::: {.csf-card .csf-card--blue}
<span class="csf-card__icon"><i class="bi bi-megaphone-fill"></i></span>

### One person who says "let's"
Someone to pick a date and send the first message. That could be you.
:::
:::
:::

::: {.csf-section}
<p class="csf-section__kicker">starting one</p>
<h2 class="csf-section__title">How we'd start it, together</h2>

::: {.csf-steps}
- ### Write to us
  A message on Instagram, TikTok or YouTube. Tell us your city and who you think might
  come.

- ### We share what we know
  The recipes that work with a crowd, what to buy, and how we run an evening from the
  first hello to the last spoon.

- ### Host your first one
  Pick an easy dessert, invite a few people, and let everyone make it together. Keep it
  small the first time.

- ### Send us the photos
  Tell us how it went. Then do it again next month, and watch the group grow.
:::
:::

::: {.csf-section}
<p class="csf-section__kicker">same spirit everywhere</p>
<h2 class="csf-section__title">The few things every city keeps</h2>
<p class="csf-section__sub">
Every city will have its own recipes and its own crowd. These four things stay the same,
because they're what make it work.
</p>

::: {.csf-checks}
- **Free to join.** Nobody pays at the door. Ingredients stay cheap so it stays that way.
- **No competition.** We make one dessert together, as a team. Nobody wins, everybody eats.
- **No fire needed.** No oven, no stove, so any room works and anyone can take part.
- **Everybody's welcome.** Especially the person who's new and came on their own.
:::
:::

::: {.csf-band .csf-band--butter}
<span class="csf-band__icon"><i class="bi bi-send-fill"></i></span>
